title: Input schema of the Glassdoor Interview Question Scraper

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: URLs to start with. Use Glassdoor interview listing / company pages or search results (ensure you have permission).

companies.title: Companies to tag
companies.description: Optional list of company names to prioritize or tag results with.

roles.title: Roles to filter
roles.description: Optional list of role keywords (e.g., 'software engineer') to focus the crawl.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of requests that can be made by this crawler.
